title: Python-first orchestration control plane (outside kbs binary)
description:
Architecture pivot: orchestration logic lives in a standalone Python utility that calls kbs/kanbus as execution primitives.

Why:
- Orchestration has no hot inner loop requiring Rust compilation into kbs.
- Keeping orchestration outside Rust avoids Python/Rust parity drag for this workstream.
- kbs remains the fast issue/index primitive and source-of-truth operations surface.

Scope:
- Python utility owns orchestration control flow, worker lifecycle, and policy wiring.
- Utility may invoke either kbs or kanbus commands for issue/run operations.
- No requirement to implement orchestration feature parity inside Rust and Python for this utility layer.
